testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-20 Dimension pick can change the active distance expression: tmp/obk-pr4184-ci-logs/pinned/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:223:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-20 Dimension pick can change the active distance expression ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given two disjoint closed loops and one rectangle selected for extrusion ✔ When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Measure ✔ Then the status area asks the user to select a dimension to reference the parameter ✔ When the circle dimension annotation is picked ✔ Then Distance A references d2 instead of adding another profile ✔ And a later pick produces invalid d2d2 and disabled OK ✔ When Cancel is clicked ✔ Then no new extrusion is accepted
